scan.policy: Last 1,000,000 blocks, complete factory event query; previous 14 pools plus up to 24 recent pools prioritising non-leaf assets. Daily rescan after active screens settle. Bounded coverage, not the whole chain.

hypothesis.failureCondition: Reject at the ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations meet both entry thresholds, or if any eligible quote fails the configured route/size checks. Do not interpret passing the screen as acceptance or profit. Preserve the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation gate; unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model invoice costs remain excluded from any full-profit claim.
hypothesis.name: wPONS four-hop size-curve probe
hypothesis.rationale: Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: this WETH → USDG → PONS → wPONS → WETH route could show size-dependent net quote behavior across its supplied exact sizes. SIZE_CURVE must quote every supplied exact size up to 0.005 WETH and select the greatest current after-gas net; it must not scale outputs. Enter only when the selected quote meets the 20 bps edge floor and covers the 15000 bps gas-safety requirement for two consecutive eligible observations. The supplied training data does not validate this forward hypothesis.

result.boundary: Ten-observation prospective futility screen followed by longer forward collection for promising ideas. This is not seven-day acceptance. Signals assume known gas only, are not fills or complete profit, and do not authorize a policy change.

Training blocks 96049192 and 96066325 are examples of the forward observations recorded in the prior trials; they do not validate this new route or cell.
